target.description: The target in canonical form: the address, or AS and the number.

asn_name.description: The name IPtoASN gives the AS.

asn_country.description: The two-letter country where the AS is registered. null when IPtoASN names none.

prefix.description: The IPtoASN prefix that holds the address. null for an AS target.

ipv4_prefix_count.description: All IPv4 prefixes of the AS, before paging.

ipv6_prefix_count.description: All IPv6 prefixes of the AS, before paging.

limit.description: Most prefixes of each family on this page: the limit argument, 50 by default.

offset.description: Items skipped: the offset argument, 0 by default.

next_offset.description: offset plus the length of the longer list on this page. The next page starts there. When it is not below the larger of ipv4_prefix_count and ipv6_prefix_count, this page is the last.

ipv4_prefixes.description: This page of IPv4 prefixes in CIDR form, in address order.

ipv6_prefixes.description: This page of IPv6 prefixes in CIDR form, in address order.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
